title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, consolidate caching, bump actions
author: Lena Park
description:
Motivation: our monolithic CI workflow has accumulated a lot of conditional logic to handle lint, unit tests, integration tests, and release automation. This makes runs slow, cache keys brittle, and iteration painful when modifying one area. This PR splits the pipeline into three focused workflows (lint, test, release), consolidates reusable caching helpers, standardizes cache key patterns across repos, and bumps a set of GitHub Actions used by the pipeline for security/hygiene. It also includes a small dependency bump (actions/checkout, node-setup action) and minor package.json scripts and docs updates.

What I changed (summary):
- Add .github/workflows/lint.yml: standalone lint job matrix, faster fast-fail linting.
- Add .github/workflows/test.yml: split unit and integration flows, stable matrix caching.
- Add .github/workflows/release.yml: isolated release job with improved permissions and required approvals for prod tags.
- Introduce .github/actions/cache-helpers for standardized cache key generation and restore/save steps (used by lint/test workflows).
- Small upgrades: bump actions/checkout@v4 -> @v4.2, setup-node bump to v4; align Node matrix to 18/20 where needed.
- Update package.json scripts to expose ci:lint, ci:test, ci:release wrappers and add CI-targeted env handling.
- Update docs/ci.md with new workflow descriptions and debugging tips.

Checklist: 
- [x] Split workflows created and smoke-tested locally via act style runs.
- [x] Cache helper action added and unit tests for key logic included.
- [x] Verified flow-level secrets/permissions for release pipeline.
- [x] Updated docs.
- [x] Linear tickets linked.

Commit summary (top commits):
- refactor(ci): introduce separate lint/test/release workflows
- feat(ci): add cache-helpers action and cache key script
- chore(ci): bump GH actions versions and standardize node matrix
- docs(ci): update CI runbook and debugging tips

Changed areas (high level): the main changes are in .github workflows and helper scripts; small adjustments to package.json and test/jest configs to ensure deterministic behavior in CI. The release path was left intentionally conservative: no change to release artifacts beyond permissions and environment hygiene.

Review notes and rationale: splitting workflows reduces the average executor time and improves cache locality (lint jobs no longer restore huge test caches). The cache-helpers action encapsulates key derivation and makes it easier to maintain consistent caching across repositories in follow-up PRs. The action version bumps are small but reduce security warnings from Dependabot and reduce noise in our security dashboard.

CI and perf expectations: expected 15-30% reduction in median CI wall time for PRs that only touch lint/test files, and faster feedback for authors. Release workflow now runs only on tag/merge to main with explicit approval gate.

Merge: squashed and merged to main after approvals and CI green.
